product_overview: SmartEnergy is an advanced real-time energy monitoring and management platform designed to provide industrial and residential users with comprehensive insights into their electrical consumption and cost. It features a customizable dashboard displaying multi-phase electrical parameters such as voltage, current, power factor, and accumulated energy, supported by powerful visualization tools and real-time data streaming from ESP32-based devices.
core_goals: Provide accurate real-time monitoring of electrical parameters across 3-phase power systems.
Enable users to customize their dashboard views for tailored insights and enhanced usability.
Support multi-language (English and Thai) and theme preferences to improve accessibility and user experience.
Facilitate efficient device and user management, including authentication and firmware updates.
Ensure data accuracy, security, and system performance with scalable backend infrastructure.
key_features: Customizable real-time dashboard with drag-and-drop grid layouts and view modes (Default and Custom).
Comprehensive energy monitoring widgets including energy cost, active power, voltage, current, power factor, energy accumulation, and statistical analysis.
Real-time data visualization with WebSocket streaming and historical trend charts using Recharts and ApexCharts.
Device management capabilities such as ESP32 device registration, firmware OTA updates, and connection status monitoring.
User authentication with JWT-based login, role-based access control, and full CRUD for user management.
Internationalization supporting English and Thai languages with localized formats for date, time, and currency.
Light and Dark theme options with preferences saved for consistent experience.
Backend data ingestion service integrating ESP32 power meters via HTTP POST into InfluxDB for efficient time-series data management.
user_flow_summary: User logs in via the JWT-secured authentication system; admin users access user and device management panels.
Users select or customize their dashboard layout to view relevant energy monitoring widgets in real-time.
ESP32 devices continuously send measurement data to the backend, which processes and stores it for display and historical analysis.
Users analyze energy consumption and cost data, switch between different devices or locations, and export reports as needed.
Administrators manage users and devices, perform firmware updates, and monitor device connection status.
Users switch languages between English and Thai and toggle theme preferences between Light and Dark modes, with preferences persisted across sessions.
validation_criteria: Real-time dashboard loads within 2 seconds and updates charts under 100 milliseconds.
Data accuracy achieves a 99.9% match with physical meter readings.
System maintains 99.5% uptime availability with support for up to 100 concurrent ESP32 devices.
Security enforced with HTTPS, JWT token authentication, and password hashing.
User interface is responsive and functions correctly across the latest 2 versions of major browsers and mobile devices.
All user management features (login, CRUD operations) and device management (registration, firmware update) operate without errors.
Internationalization and theme preferences persist correctly and localizations are accurate for English and Thai.
Energy data ingestion and real-time data streaming via WebSocket work reliably with minimal latency.
